column1: # help-builtins - the builtin one-liners: name<TAB>call<TAB>meaning, ONE ROW PER MEANING.
# Order is display order; the FIRST row of a name is what the REPL hint (.help.oneline) shows.
# call: one idiomatic invocation, <=36 chars, copy-paste executable where it can be.
# meaning: lowercase verb phrase, no trailing period, a whole thought on its own.
# The RESULT column is NOT here - tools/gen-help-builtins.py witnesses it by running the call.
# Longer explanations are the website's job (\??topic). Edit this file, rerun the generator, commit both.
